operator.payload: Should duplicate selections (for example `--field Status --field-id PVTSSF_status`) produce two columns in the requested order, or be deduplicated into one column?
operator.answer: OPERATOR_ANSWER: `--field` and `--field-id` cannot be combined, so that example must fail. Repeated selections within either single form produce columns in the requested order; do not deduplicate them.

operator.payload: When `--format` is used, should `--field`/`--field-id` be rejected as incompatible (leaving JSON output unchanged), or should selected fields alter exported output too?
operator.answer: OPERATOR_ANSWER: Reject `--field` and `--field-id` when `--format` is used. Formatted/JSON output remains unchanged when no field-selection flag is supplied.

operator.payload: For multi-value project fields (labels, users, reviewers, and pull requests), should the table cell join values with `, `, while repository and pull-request values use their URLs and iterations/milestones use their titles?
operator.answer: OPERATOR_ANSWER: Yes. Join multi-value entries with `, `. Use URLs for pull requests and repositories; use titles for iterations and milestones.

findings.title: Shared field-list query behavior was changed outside selected item-list invocations
findings.evidence: pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries.go:847,864,881 change the existing `*OwnerWithFields.Project()` conversions to `newProjectFromQueryBase`; lines 1175-1236 replace their project type with `projectQueryBase`. The same diff removes `firstItems` and `afterItems` from `ProjectFields` requests, as reflected in pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries_test.go:421-559.
findings.why: `ProjectFields` is a shared, pre-existing path. This changes its GraphQL request shape even when no new item-list selection flag is used, contrary to the approved requirement that existing field-query behavior remain unchanged.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the existing `ProjectFields` query structs and variables intact. Introduce separate base-only query wrapper types exclusively for `RemainingProjectFields` continuation requests.

findings.title: Focused tests do not cover required pagination-failure and value-rendering behavior
findings.evidence: pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/queries_test.go:562-620 tests only one successful continuation page and the no-next-page helper path; it has no multi-continuation or error case and does not exercise item-list rendering suppression. pkg/cmd/project/item-list/item_list_fields_test.go:27-120 covers date, iteration, labels, number, single-select, text, milestone, repository, and unknown values, but omits pull-request, user, and reviewer renderings.
findings.why: The public task explicitly requires conditional full field pagination including failure-before-render, plus tests for all supported field-value renderings. The passing focused test log therefore does not validate important claimed behavior, especially that a failed later field page produces no table output.
findings.suggestedFix: Add command-level request tests for multiple continuation pages and continuation failure with an empty output buffer, and add renderer cases for pull requests, users, reviewers, and absent field values.

reviewerResult.summary: The diff changes a frozen shared field-query path and lacks focused coverage for several required behaviors.
